references.text: The original command to make the sash of finely twisted linen with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, in embroidered work.
Describes the same materials (blue, purple, and scarlet yarn) that were used for the priestly garments.
The same materials and craftsmanship technique (embroidered work) used for the curtain at the entrance of the tent.
The curtain for the gate of the courtyard was also made of finely twisted linen with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn in embroidered work.
The same materials and technique used in making the curtain at the entrance of the tent.
The sash on the ephod was made of the same materials: gold, blue, purple, scarlet yarn, and finely twisted linen.
Direct connection between God's command regarding the sash (chapter 28) and its actual execution (chapter 39).
